question.text: Two full turns of the circular scale of a screw gauge cover a distance of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>1</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math> on its main scale. The total number of divisions on the circular scale is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn></math>. Further, it is found that the screw gauge has a zero error of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mn>0.03</mn><mo> </mo><mi>mm</mi></math>.
